description: This file defines the DeleteSubjectResponse class, representing the response to a delete subject command within the policies modification context of the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes methods for creating instances from parameters or JSON, manages JSON serialization, and overrides methods for equality, hashing, and string representation.

classes.name: DeleteSubjectResponse
classes.description: Immutable response class for the delete subject command, providing methods to create and serialize responses, and manage associated policy, label, and subject identifiers.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a DeleteSubjectResponse instance with specified policyId, label, subjectId, and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a DeleteSubjectResponse instance from a JSON string or JSON object.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns the PolicyId associated with this response.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Builds the JSON pointer path to the resource represented by this response.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Serializes the response payload into JSON.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance with updated Ditto headers.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns hash code for the object.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the object.
